Container.Name: IPTV-Gateway
Container.Overview: Curate your IPTV providers once, use the line-up on every box. IPTV Gateway merges Xtream Codes / M3U sources into bouquets with their own logins: pick, rename, group, order and number channels in a web UI. Every box logging in with that bouquet (TiviMate, Formuler/MyTVOnline, Smarters, OTT Navigator, ...) gets exactly the same line-up and guide. It also gives you cleaner channel names, a better EPG (optional extra XMLTV sources, matched automatically), catch-up/timeshift pass-through and Plex Live TV & DVR via HDHomeRun emulation. It is lightweight: one native binary, and video goes straight from the provider to the box by default (an optional relay exists for use abroad). Contains no content; bring your own legitimate sources. Getting started: https://github.com/IPTVGateway/IPTVGateway/blob/main/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md
Container.Description: IPTV Gateway: merge, filter, rename and sort multiple IPTV providers into bouquets and republish them as your own Xtream portal + EPG. The admin web UI is bundled: open the WebUI (port 7777). Only the Data folder is needed; config.json is created there on first start (edit it via Settings in the web UI).

Config.Name: Admin + Xtream (HTTP)
Config.Description: Admin REST API + Xtream/M3U output portal + XMLTV + Plex endpoints. Point your IPTV box / Plex here.

Config.Name: Stream proxy
Config.Description: Relay port — only listens when proxyStreams=true in config.json (use abroad / when the box can only reach this server).

Config.Name: SSDP (Plex discovery)
Config.Description: UDP 1900 — lets Plex auto-discover the HDHomeRun tuner. LAN-only, NEVER forward to the internet. Note: SSDP does not cross Docker bridge NAT — for auto-discovery use Network Type 'host', otherwise add the tuner in Plex by URL and you can ignore this port.

Config.Name: Data (SQLite db + state)
Config.Description: Persistent storage: config.json + the SQLite catalog/lists/EPG. Survives restarts/updates. TIP: SQLite's fast WAL mode needs a real filesystem — it does NOT work on the /mnt/user FUSE share. The app detects this and still works (single connection), but for a UI that stays snappy during the daily refresh, point this at a cache/local path instead, e.g. /mnt/cache/appdata/iptv-gateway/data.

Config.Name: Languages (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: drop add-on UI translation files here (one <code>.json per language, e.g. de.json). English and Dutch are built in. Pick the language under Settings. Leave default if you don't need extra languages.

Config.Name: Timezone (TZ)
Config.Description: Local time for the daily channel + EPG refresh.

Config.Name: User ID (PUID)
Config.Description: The container runs as this user, not as root (99 = nobody, Unraid's default for appdata). The data folder is handed to it on start. 0 = run as root like older versions.

Config.Name: Group ID (PGID)
Config.Description: Group of that user (100 = users, Unraid's default).

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the admin UI/API (the /api surface). Empty = open (LAN only!). Does NOT affect the Xtream box endpoints, which use their own output credentials. Overrides adminPassword in config.json.
